title: Game fields the update retyped: read as the new type or through its holder
text: The type `field, game: linked`, after #156 left reads of another type than the old release's as written. A read of a field the update retyped is taken as the new type where every use of its value means the same of it (calls the new type has with the same arguments, game calls whose parameter changed with it, typed arguments, null tests; not ==, instanceof, stores, values a jump carries, or Object arguments), as Level.random became a RandomSource. Otherwise it is turned into the old type as the game's own code gets what a holder of the new type holds (holder.value(), option.get() unboxed), learned from the new release's classes. A nested platform module's version and a name the old platform answered to (Fabric API's 'fabric', dropped in 26.3) are asked of the new platform, read by the port itself from the two Fabric API jars.
finish: the type's finishes and mods counts fall, newest and big-updates up, load on a real server and client where it frees the most
wrongIf: a mod this frees fails in a real game
result: On main at #156: type finishes 19 -> 13, mods 536 -> 392 (references 791 -> 567). Every update 6,118 -> 6,124, big updates 1,952 -> 1,958, newest 17 -> 18 (AttributeFix on Fabric 1.20.1 -> 26.3), none lower. AttributeFix ported to 26.3 loads on a real server and client and applies its 40 attributes; Comforts ported to 1.19 (Level.random) loads on a real server.
